title: 第26章 刘施施老师
content_zh:
第26章 刘施施老师-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

《无法原谅》是《回家的诱惑》主题曲，而《偏爱》则是《仙剑三》插曲。

论影响力，《无法原谅》完全比不过《偏爱》

蔡怡农不是专业歌手，她是电视剧制作人。

艺术都是共同的，这女人审美在线。

听了几遍以后，她就下定决心要把这两首歌放到《仙剑三》里面。

这两首歌太合适了。

尤其是《偏爱》，歌曲精准契合紫萱与徐长卿的三世虐恋，“把昨天都作废，现在你在我眼前”的歌词成为角色情感的代名词。

如果导演和编剧在这里，会和她的想法一样。

把MP3放回桌上，蔡怡农盯着魏沐看了好一会，问：“这两首歌我要了，你开个价吧。”

魏沐没有说价格，他神情平静：“蔡姐，我从小就喜欢玩电子游戏，仙剑三是我最爱的游戏之一，我这两首歌就是为仙剑三量身定做，我可以把它们授权给电视剧，不要钱。”

不要钱？

蔡怡农挑了挑眉毛，惊讶于这小子的脸皮厚度。

你白送，老娘能白要吗？

你小子年纪不大，心眼子怎么这么多！！

她混迹娱乐圈多年，非常清楚，免费的才是最贵的。

说来说去，还是想要徐长卿这个角色。

“你先回去吧，好好考虑签约的事情。”

“好，那我先走了。”

魏沐没打算第一次就拿下角色，很干脆的走了。

在走之前，他从桌上拿走MP3。

蔡怡农看了一眼，没说话。

待人离开，她紧紧抓着桌子上的简历资料，有些头疼。

本以为是一件小事，没想到弄成这样。

从办公室离开，魏沐没有马上走，他还想参观一下2008年的唐人影视公司。

路过休息区的时候，魏沐瞅了眼里面，没想到还真有熟人。

沙发上坐着一个女孩，她双腿盘坐，长长的头发束起，长相清丽，眼睛死死盯着手机，好像在跟谁聊天。

这不是瞎姐嘛。

注意到有人看过来，刘施施抬起头，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。

这人好脸熟啊。

大脑放空两秒，她终于想起来这人是谁。

这不是那谁吗，那个唱歌的帅哥。

叫什么来着.....哎呀我脑子真笨，还没想起来。

正想着，那人走了过来打招呼：“你好，我叫魏沐。”

“你.....你好。我叫刘施施。”

刘施施嘴里嘟囔着，眼睛一亮。

原来叫这个名字。

魏沐很自来熟的坐在她旁边，好奇询问：“你是唐人的艺人吧？”

“你怎么知道？”

"Unforgiven" is the theme song of "The Temptation of Going Home", while "Preference" is the episode song of "Sword and Sword III".

In terms of influence, "Unforgiven" is completely inferior to "Preferred"

Cai Yinong is not a professional singer, she is a TV series producer.

Art is all common, and this woman's aesthetic is online.

After listening to it several times, she made up her mind to include these two songs in "Sword and Sword III".

These two songs are so suitable.

Especially "Preference", the song accurately fits the three-generation sadomasochism between Zixuan and Xu Changqing. The lyrics "Void yesterday, now you are in front of me" have become synonymous with the characters' emotions.

If the director and screenwriter were here, they would have the same idea as her.

Putting the MP3 back on the table, Cai Yinong stared at Wei Mu for a while and asked, "I want these two songs. Please give me a price."

Wei Mu did not say the price. He looked calm: "Sister Cai, I have loved playing video games since I was a child. Sword and Sword III is one of my favorite games. These two songs of mine are tailor-made for Sword and Sword III. I can license them to the TV series for free."

Don’t want money?

Cai Yinong raised his eyebrows, surprised by the thickness of this boy's skin.

You gave it away for free, can I ask for it for free?

You are not very young, but you are so smart!!

She has been in the entertainment industry for many years and knows very well that free is the most expensive.

All said and done, I still want the role of Xu Changqing.

"You should go back first and think about the signing."

"Okay, I'll leave first."

Wei Mu had no intention of winning the role the first time, so he left simply.

Before leaving, he took the MP3 player from the table.

Cai Yinong glanced at it but said nothing.

When people left, she clutched the resume information on the table tightly, feeling a little headache.

I thought it was a small thing, but I didn't expect it to turn out like this.

After leaving the office, Wei Mu did not leave immediately. He also wanted to visit the 2008 Tangren Film and Television Company.

When passing by the rest area, Wei Mu glanced inside, but he didn't expect that there was someone he knew.

There is a girl sitting on the sofa. She sits cross-legged, her long hair is tied up, she looks pretty, and her eyes are fixed on the phone, as if she is chatting with someone.

Isn’t this a blind girl?

Noticing someone looking over, Liu Shishi raised his head, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.

This guy looks so familiar.

After her mind went blank for two seconds, she finally remembered who this person was.

Isn't that who he is? The handsome guy who sings.

What's it called... Oops, I'm so stupid, I haven't remembered it yet.

Just as he was thinking about it, the man came over and said hello: "Hello, my name is Wei Mu."

"Hello. My name is Liu Shishi."

Liu Shishi muttered and his eyes lit up.

It was originally called this.

Wei Mu sat next to her very familiarly and asked curiously: "Are you an artist from the Tang Dynasty?"

"How do you know?"
